2607.29397.title: Studying quantization trade-offs for efficient inference deployment in machine translation
2607.29397.paper_summary: Deploying large language models in realistic server environments poses challenges, as the system needs to provide high-quality responses with low latency. Quantization is a common approach to reduce the memory footprint and improve inference efficiency, yet its impact on latency and throughput is rarely evaluated under controlled, orchestration-level workloads. In this work we study the quantization trade-offs of two translation model families, EuroLLM \citep{martins2025eurollm} and Hy-MT2 \citep{zheng2026hy} across five models ranging from 1.7B to 22B for efficient deployment on a single A100 or H100 GPU. We demonstrate that combining a document-chunking strategy with W4A8 or W8A8 quantization improves the latency-throughput Pareto-curve under a wide range of workloads. Furthermore, since standard machine translation (MT) benchmarks rely on isolated sentences and fail to capture long-context dynamics, we introduce a document-level evaluation from WMT24++ to assess how text chunking strategies affect translation quality under quantization. Our results reveal that standard segment-level evaluation can fail to predict the interaction between quantization and long-context document translation. While Hy-MT2 remains robust under quantization, EuroLLM shows strong sensitivity and translation quality collapses rapidly for all considered quantization formats. Overall, our experiments show that the trade-off between inference efficiency and translation quality depends not only on the quantization format, but also on the choice of text chunking strategy.
2607.29397.paper_summary_zh: 在現實的伺服器環境中部署大型語言模型面臨挑戰，因為系統需要提供高品質的回應且延遲低。量化是一種常見的方法，用以減少記憶體佔用並提高推斷效率，但其對延遲和吞吐量的影響在受控的編排級工作負載下很少被評估。在這項工作中，我們研究了兩個翻譯模型系列的量化權衡，EuroLLM \citep{martins2025eurollm} 和 Hy-MT2 \citep{zheng2026hy}，涵蓋五個模型，範圍從 1.7B 到 22B，以便在單個 A100 或 H100 GPU 上高效部署。我們證明，將文檔分塊策略與 W4A8 或 W8A8 量化相結合，可以在廣泛的工作負載下改善延遲-吞吐量的 Pareto 曲線。此外，由於標準機器翻譯 (MT) 基準依賴於孤立的句子，無法捕捉長上下文的動態，我們引入了來自 WMT24++ 的文檔級評估，以評估文本分塊策略在量化下如何影響翻譯質量。我們的結果顯示，標準的段落級評估可能無法預測量化與長上下文文檔翻譯之間的相互作用。雖然 Hy-MT2 在量化下仍然穩健，但 EuroLLM 顯示出強烈的敏感性，並且在所有考慮的量化格式下翻譯質量迅速崩潰。總體而言，我們的實驗顯示，推斷效率與翻譯質量之間的權衡不僅依賴於量化格式，還取決於文本分塊策略的選擇。
